subject: overlaying a shaded rectangle on a line plot

messages.author: 732a31c2f861aaca
messages.subject: overlaying a shaded rectangle on a line plot
parts:
Hi I am trying to make a simple line plot with a shaded rectangle over
a specified area but I can't overcome the date format needed in the
plot.

This is what I have,

ggplot(LSG556,aes(Date,LongNeg)) + geom_line() + scale_x_date(major =
"4 days",format="%d/%m") +
xlab("Date") + ylab("Longitude")+
geom_rect(xmin = as.Date("2009-09-22"), xmax = as.Date("2009-10-11"),
ymin = Inf, ymax = -Inf)


I then get the following error
"Error in seq.int(r1$year, to$year, by) : wrong sign in 'by' argument"

Any help would be appreciated

Rob

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: overlaying a shaded rectangle on a line plot
parts:
Hi:

I think your ymin and ymax have the wrong signs :)

Here's an example I manufactured that seems to do what you want:

x <- seq(from = as.Date('2010-01-01'), to = as.Date('2010-11-30'), by = 'day')
df <- data.frame(x = x, y = rnorm(334))
g <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_path() + scale_x_date(major = 'month', format = '%m/%y')
g + geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, xmin = as.Date('2010-03-01'),
               xmax = as.Date('2010-06-01')), fill = alpha('red', 0.1),
               ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)

More or less borrowed from the example on p. 86 of Hadley's book...

HTH,
Dennis
